angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 570,474 km at 101.38 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.8638 +/- 0.0155 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 101.38 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.82 +/- 0.005 solar radii from Bonfanti et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5624 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A.265B/abstract): 570,474 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.858 +/- 0.033 solar masses from Bonfanti et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5624 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A.265B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5327 +/- 64 K from Bonfanti et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5624 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A.265B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Bonfanti et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5624 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A.265B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-5624.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.544, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+50 1888: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5624 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.023 dex, from Bonfanti et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A.265B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5624 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.31336, from Bonfanti et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A.265B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5624 (pscomppars): age 5.7 Gyr, from Bonfanti et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A.265B/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5624 (pscomppars): rotation period 20 d, from Bonfanti et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A.265B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5624 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Bonfanti et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A.265B/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.82 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.964. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
